descriptionChirho: Basic additive conjunction indicating addition or inclusion; cross-linguistically uniform: eng 'also', spa 'también', hin 'भी', arb 'أيضًا', kor '또한', swa 'pia'.

Scalar/concessive particle emphasizing an unexpected or extreme case; distinguished by swa 'hata' (not 'pia'), kor '심지어' (not '또한'), arb occasionally 'حتّى', spa 'aun' (not 'también'), indicating a genuinely different lexical selection across languages.
Paired correlative conjunction used in 'both X and Y' constructions; evidenced by spa 'tanto...como', eng 'both...and', swa 'wote', hin 'चाहे', distinguishing it from simple additive 'also'.

Emphatic affirmative particle expressing strong assertion or confirmation; cross-linguistic evidence is distinctive: hin 'हाँ' (yes), swa 'Naam' (yes), kor '참으로' (truly), arb 'بل' (rather/indeed), eng 'indeed/moreover'.

Used in rhetorical or genuine questions meaning 'is it also?/has he even?'; identified by question markers across languages: hin 'क्या' (question particle), arb 'هل' (interrogative), spa '¿acaso/¿también', swa 'je' (question marker).

Negative-polarity conjunction meaning 'neither/nor' in negative contexts; sharply distinguished cross-linguistically: swa 'wala' (neither), spa 'ni' (nor), hin 'न तो/हअन' (neither), while eng retains 'also' masking the distinction.

Causal conjunction in the compound form בְּשַׁגַּם meaning 'because also/inasmuch as'; uniquely translated as spa 'porque también', hin 'क्योनकि' (because), arb 'لأنّه' (because), swa 'kwa sababu pia' (because also).
